source.numeric: only Data without fit/Faraday/<channel>/<channel>_<repeat>.csv. No archived fits, joint parameter files, publication data-with-fit files, Voigt records or notebook outputs. The pre-fit measured acquisition has two columns of calibrated detuning GHz and recorded transmission. Authored FFT Hilbert and 750-bin reduction are prior methods. Never use a target-specific fit, shift, normalization or off-band background.

endpoint: filter transmission for input horizontal and crossed vertical analyzer. Four repeats under one enriched 2mm cell condition. All four raw filter ordinate columns held until four separate source-only predictions durably locked.
measurement: Prior methods and joint-fit aggregate agreement published. Frequency reference from atomic reference and etalon. Trusted source extraction of target-axis-only from both-column CSV before lock. The fit-all archive is never consulted. Joint posterior frequency/angle offsets are unavailable to predictors, no independent absolute crossed angle readout established.
axis: Use 750 fixed equal-width bins per complete 170000-row target detuning axis min to max, centers midpoints, source transmissions averaged using same bins. Require all bins nonempty and both circular averages >0. Refuse without clipping/flooring if unsupported. Literal per-channel FFT method also averages each entire circular scan into its own 750 uniform bins, HT then interpolates to target centers with constant nearest extension at sub-bin outer ends. Require positive finite means. Record original axes digests. Retain all rows; native descriptive predictions piecewise constant within each target bin. Compare own-axis direct Hilbert as a source-faithful finite-bin construction. The deposited notebook uses empirical bin mean detunings; this comparison uses nominal equally spaced bin centers consistently on each axis. No claim of bitwise recreation of published fits or figures.

model.source: Fit per repeat by equally weighting the three complete binned source transmissions. Both circular names may map to either native eigenmode convention; fit alternatives for this assignment from circular inputs only. Select the lowest squared source discrepancy. Two parameter starts (T75/105C,B6000G), source-only bounded least squares, maximum40 function evaluations each. Local finite differences absolute [.15 C,2 G,1 MHz,1 MHz,1 MHz] to resolve native grid. Model evaluates causal native complex indices sqrt(1+chi). Relative source shifts L,R and −L−R on horizontal, centered so predicted crossed channel receives only the common shift. Relative shifts used for fitting physical model, no outcome-derived alignment. Fixed weak beam, no extra homogeneous pressure broadening, no extra detector background/gain or window retardance.

formula: Ideal crossed I=(TL+TR−2sqrt(TL TR)cos(delta+2beta))/4. Circular differential phase for a causal transparent-high-frequency minimum-phase cell with weighted equal transfer paths is .5*H(logTL−logTR). Hybrid = fitted native cell phase + .5*H[(logTL−logTR)−(logTL_model−logTR_model)] on the full common grid. Model-difference term is evaluated in observed channel coordinates at the common shift for the held axis. All amplitudes are reported source-bin means except pure native source fit. Off-band/unobserved phase and unknown polarizer angle remain limitations. Flip of atomic wing correction and fixed ±1° give diagnostics only. Signed output labels do not identify handedness from a single crossed intensity.
acceptance: For each of the four separately indexed acquisitions the primary requires smaller whole-spectrum binned RMSE than common-grid FFT, source-only ElecSus, author-style own-axes FFT, zero-phase and incoherent. Any tie, loss or pre-read source refusal blocks the gate. Recount all RMSE/MAE, raw full acquisitions and maximum original and binned residuals plus same-row alternatives. Comparisons are four scans under one setup, correlated across frequency and repeats, without mechanical or new uncertainty calibration.
roles_detail: half_incoherent = (TL+TR)/4, suppressing interference. Pure source-fit applies native complex susceptibilities and model amplitudes; pure_model_phase_measured_amplitudes uses native phase and empirical amplitudes. Polarizer beta fixed to zero except explicit ±1° sensitivity. Source diagnostic exact bound |hybrid−direct| ≤ sqrt(TL TR)|sin((delta_model−delta_model_windowed)/2)|.
geometry_excluded: No source or target from naturally abundant Voigt cell. Report labels/denominator for each Faraday repeat. Complete four predictions required before opening any filtered ordinate, even if a subset passes positivity. No synthetic replacement for a refused repeat.
